text: Alla Harminanii on ko : maayi jiibi e kulle ɗen, e ƴiiƴam rufaaɗam, e teewu kose, e kon ewnoraa hirsugol ko wanaa Innde Alla, e ɗeɗɗii kon maayi, e luuaa=lukkangol kol maayi, e unii(yanngol) kol maayi, juraa(juwangol) kol maayi, e ko kulle ɗen ñaami(conngi) -si wanaa kon ko hewtitiɗon hirsuɗon ado maayde ; ɗum ɗon no dagii, O Harminanii on kadi ko hirsanaa sanamu, e nde ɗaɓɓoton senndirgol payanɗe mon ɗun ko kaaje maa laane na winnda e mum(waɗ) woto (waɗ) refi golle ko ɗeen mbipi ko, gollugol ɗum ko ko harmi e mon te ko yaltugol e ɗoftaare Alla. Hannde heeferɓe ɓen taƴike nde murtoton yalton e diina Lislaamu kan, wata on huluɓe, hulee Lam Min. Hannde Mi Timminanii on diina mon Lislaamu kan, Mi Timminii e dow mooɗon Neemaaji Am feeñuɗi e wirniiɗi, Mi Suɓanike on Islaamu on diina ; Mi Jaɓataa diina goo ko woori Lislaamu. Kala ɓittoriiɗo heege o ñaami ko maayi hara wanaa o ooñoriiɗo bakkaatu, haray bakkaatu woo fawaaki mo. Pellet, Alla Ko Haforoowo, Hinnotooɗo.
